cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've taken my badge off like you. Two of us retiring, then. I told them no more chairing; please notice what that took.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My badge pin broke. Could you stay until we find somebody?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, leave it off. I rehearsed that refusal in your car until I stopped apologising. Please don't turn it into 'not yet'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll tell them you're exhausted and need a break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't give them the excuse I spent an hour taking out. Tell them I said no without one.
